rationale.B_target8: Hold entry/stop/risk rules fixed; test a larger gross target because 3 ATR reward is insufficient after costs. Larger target reduces hit probability, so outcomes must be measured.
rationale.C_confirmed_target8: Require stronger ADX and relative volume to test false-breakout filtering. Filters are strengthened, not removed.
rationale.D: No alternative family: one market and limited disjoint windows do not justify another search.

selection.data: train and validation only, taker scenario
selection.ranking: validation net return descending; train net return descending; variant name ascending
selection.fallback: A_baseline if no candidate passes; no winner declared
selection.final_rule: Freeze selection before any final-period simulation. Evaluate selected configuration once under taker costs; baseline benchmark once if distinct. No retuning on test.
selection.multiple_testing: Three prespecified candidates, two one-dimensional neighbors, two cost bounds. No grid search or significance claim.

accounting: Independent 5,000,000 TMN accounts per contiguous segment and window; continuous mark-to-market, no fabricated terminal liquidation. Segment results are not compounded or stitched across gaps.
limitations: Retrospective design informed by earlier baseline and 15m/1h trial; earlier periods are not blind.
Final-period OHLC exists in cache, but variant outcomes are not inspected during selection.
No historical books or fee schedule; fee observations are account-context scenarios.
All fills are simulated by existing engine; maker execution/queue probability is not modeled.
